create_hub_cache_endpoint: create an SSE endpoint for hub cache events using a HubCacheWatcher instance
run_error_handling: run error handling wrapper around an SSE event generator to catch cancellations and exceptions
subscribe_hub_cache: subscribe to hub cache events via HubCacheWatcher and receive a unique uuid and event object
unsubscribe_hub_cache: unsubscribe from hub cache events using a uuid returned from HubCacheWatcher.subscribe
run_initialization: run initialization of hub cache data for a given uuid via HubCacheWatcher.run_initialization
